summary: Completed testing of tenant-specific reports feature for Quick Wing Fleet Management. All 10 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Reports tab visible for admin users only, showing key metrics (Total Vehicles, Bookings This Month, Fleet Utilization, Team Members), Most Used Vehicles ranked list, Bookings This Week bar chart, and Summary Statistics section. Staff users correctly do NOT see the Reports tab.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/tenant/reports/summary requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: /api/tenant/reports/summary returns correct data structure for admin
Backend: /api/tenant/reports/vehicle-utilization requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: /api/tenant/reports/vehicle-utilization returns correct data structure
Backend: Reports data is tenant-scoped (vehicle counts match between endpoints)
Backend: Vehicle usage is sorted by booking count descending
Backend: Daily booking trend contains 7 days of data
Backend: Staff user denied access to reports summary (403 Admin access required)
Backend: Staff user denied access to vehicle utilization (403 Admin access required)
Backend: Super admin cannot access reports without tenant context
Frontend: Reports tab visible for admin user (master_admin)
Frontend: Reports tab shows Total Vehicles metric (3 vehicles)
Frontend: Reports tab shows Bookings This Month metric (3 bookings)
Frontend: Reports tab shows Fleet Utilization metric (66.7%)
Frontend: Reports tab shows Team Members metric (1 member)
Frontend: 'Most Used Vehicles' section displays ranked list
Frontend: 'Bookings This Week' bar chart displays daily data
Frontend: 'Summary Statistics' section displays totals
Frontend: Refresh button available on Reports tab
Frontend: Staff user does NOT see Reports tab (correct - admin only)

Vehicle usage sorted by booking count for 'Most Used Vehicles' ranking
Daily booking trend provides 7-day rolling window
